n552b8ac72f.headline: Stock Markets Likely To Open Lower, Brent Crude Jumps 2.87% To $72.87 Amid Middle East Crisis
n552b8ac72f.summary: Indian stock markets are expected to open lower as Middle East tensions escalate and Brent crude rises 2.8% to $72.87. Higher oil prices may raise inflation and weigh on India's economy.
n552b8ac72f.why: India is a large net oil importer, so higher crude prices tend to feed into inflation, the current account and corporate margins.

impacts.why: The input states Brent rose 2.8% to USD 72.87 amid the Middle East crisis.

n552b8ac72f.why_moved: Brent crude rose about 2.8% on Middle East tensions, and analysts expect higher oil prices to weigh on Indian stocks.

n6c7d8febb0.headline: Israel closes Gaza’s Rafah crossing amid attacks on Iran
n6c7d8febb0.summary: Israel closed the Rafah crossing between Gaza and Egypt, which is considered vital for delivering humanitarian aid and evacuating critically ill patients. The closure came amid attacks on Iran.
n6c7d8febb0.why: Border closures affect aid flows and regional stability, which feed into Middle East risk premiums for investors.

n0065680a62.headline: World Bank secures new grant deal for electricity market development in Central Asia
n0065680a62.summary: The Central Asia Water and Energy Program, administered by the World Bank, signed a $3.2 million grant agreement with the Coordination and Dispatch Center in Tashkent. The grant supports electricity market development.
n0065680a62.why: The World Bank is a multilateral lender, and grants for power market reform can affect the investment climate for energy sector projects.

n99dd2739ce.headline: 3 American troops killed, and Trump says more 'likely,' in war against Iran
n99dd2739ce.summary: Three U.S. service members were killed, the first American casualties since operation "Epic Fury" began on Saturday. President Trump said there would likely be more.
n99dd2739ce.why: Direct US military involvement in a Middle East war affects defence spending, oil markets and broader risk sentiment.

source.name: WKU Public Radio | The Public Radio Service of Western Kentucky University

sources.name: WKU Public Radio | The Public Radio Service of Western Kentucky University

n379e8d4663.headline: Shiv Sena’s Shaina NC Condoles Khamenei’s Death, Urges Focus On Safety Of Indian Nationals Amid Israel-Iran War
n379e8d4663.summary: A reported US-Israel strike killed Iran's Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei. Commentary flagged rising oil prices and possible effects on India's basmati rice exports.
n379e8d4663.why: Iran is a major oil producer, and its leadership and stability shape Middle East supply risk that drives global energy prices.
n379e8d4663.why_moved: The killing of Iran's Supreme Leader raises fears of wider conflict and supply disruption, which the input links to rising oil prices.

nff5bebfdd7.headline: OpenAI gives Pentagon AI model access after Anthropic dustup
nff5bebfdd7.summary: OpenAI has agreed to deploy its artificial intelligence models within the Defense Department's classified network, after rival Anthropic's relationship with the Pentagon broke down over surveillance and autonomous weapons concerns.
nff5bebfdd7.why: OpenAI is a leading AI developer, and government contracts for AI models are a growing revenue and policy area for technology firms.

n7ff24af60f.headline: US and Israel launch new wave of attacks on Iran amid threat of escalation
n7ff24af60f.summary: The US and Israel launched a new wave of attacks on Iran, with Trump threatening force 'never seen before' if Tehran pursues retaliation after Khamenei's death.
n7ff24af60f.why: Escalation involving Iran, a major oil producer, affects energy supply expectations and risk sentiment across global markets.
n7ff24af60f.why_moved: A new wave of strikes and threats of retaliation raise the risk of wider conflict affecting oil supply.

na50700de6f.headline: GST collections rise 8.1 pc to Rs 1.83 lakh crore in February
na50700de6f.summary: India's gross Goods and Services Tax collections rose 8.1% to Rs 1.83 lakh crore in February 2026, according to official data released on Sunday. The figure is up 8.1 percent from the previous month.
na50700de6f.why: GST collections are a high-frequency gauge of India's consumption and economic activity, watched by markets and policymakers.

n1f41f3e439.headline: US, Israel attack Iran
n1f41f3e439.summary: Iran's Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei was killed on Saturday, state media confirmed, after the United States and Israel launched their most ambitious attack on Iranian targets in decades.
n1f41f3e439.why: Iran is a major oil producer and sits on the Strait of Hormuz, a chokepoint for roughly a fifth of global oil supply, so military escalation there feeds directly into energy prices and risk sentiment.
n1f41f3e439.why_moved: Strikes on Iran and the killing of its Supreme Leader raised the risk of disruption to Middle East oil supply through the Strait of Hormuz.

n16df36b9ab.headline: Oil prices surge to cross $80 after US-Iran conflict engulfs Middle East and Strait of Hormuz
n16df36b9ab.summary: Oil prices jumped 13% to cross $80 per barrel for the first time since 2024 as traders priced in a major disruption to oil flows through the Middle East and the Strait of Hormuz.
n16df36b9ab.why: Brent is the leading global crude benchmark, so its moves shape fuel costs, inflation expectations and energy company earnings worldwide.
n16df36b9ab.why_moved: Traders rapidly priced in a major disruption to oil flows through the Middle East after the US-Iran conflict spread to the Strait of Hormuz.

naf460b8d5c.headline: Apple Stock Dips 3.2% to $264.18 Amid Geopolitical Tensions, But Upcoming Product Fuel Optimism for 2026
naf460b8d5c.summary: Apple closed at $264.18 on February 27, down 3.21% from the prior session. Broader concerns over the US-Israel-Iran conflict and possible oil price spikes weighed on technology shares.
naf460b8d5c.why: Apple is a large US technology company whose share price weighs heavily on major US equity indices.

impacts.name: Apple Inc.
impacts.why: Shares fell 3.21% in a session of broader market concern over the Iran conflict and oil prices.

n7d4853b9a9.headline: Gold, silver prices likely to soar tomorrow amid escalating Middle East war; what lies ahead?
n7d4853b9a9.summary: Gold and silver prices are expected to be in focus after US-Israeli strikes on Iran killed the country's supreme leader, with analysts expecting high volatility.
n7d4853b9a9.why: Gold and silver are traditional safe-haven assets that often attract demand during geopolitical stress and inflation concerns.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Elevated geopolitical tensions push investors toward safe-haven precious metals.

impacts.name: Silver
impacts.why: Silver is also treated as a safe-haven metal during geopolitical stress.

n7d4853b9a9.why_moved: Escalating Middle East conflict, including the killing of Iran's supreme leader, is expected to drive safe-haven demand for precious metals.

n0cd3dae167.headline: UPI Transactions Surge by 27% in February
n0cd3dae167.summary: UPI transactions rose 27% year on year in February to 20.39 billion, according to the report, with the total value of transactions also reported as higher.
n0cd3dae167.why: The Unified Payments Interface is India's national real-time payments system, and its volumes indicate the pace of digital payments in the economy.

n86cf734270.headline: Australian House Prices Continue to Rise in February
n86cf734270.summary: Australian house prices continued to rise solidly in February, though prices in major capitals were flat while smaller regional markets rose more strongly.
n86cf734270.why: Housing prices influence household wealth, mortgage risk and Reserve Bank of Australia policy decisions.

n7b7795f4df.headline: TCS’ market cap falls over Rs 18,000 crore last week
n7b7795f4df.summary: Tata Consultancy Services' market capitalisation dropped by Rs 18,180.89 crore last week, to Rs 9,53,872.59 crore. Equity markets remained under pressure.
n7b7795f4df.why: Tata Consultancy Services is one of India's largest IT services exporters, and its valuation carries weight in the Nifty and Sensex.

n0865b10b80.headline: Mumbai posts highest February registrations, stamp duty collection in 14 years
n0865b10b80.summary: Mumbai recorded 13,029 property registrations in February 2026, generating over Rs 1,134 crore in stamp duty. It was the highest February performance in 14 years for both measures.
n0865b10b80.why: Property registrations and stamp duty collections are indicators of housing demand and state tax revenue in India's financial capital.

n3fc4f81065.headline: 84% of Cebu CEOs see growth in 2026
n3fc4f81065.summary: Most Cebu chief executives project revenue growth in 2026 and remain optimistic about the economy, despite last year's calamities.
n3fc4f81065.why: Business sentiment among regional executives offers a gauge of local investment and consumer demand in the Philippines.

ne5642266fc.headline: Higher F&O taxes won’t deter small investors, says NSE CEO Ashish Chauhan; calls for tax-based entry filter
ne5642266fc.summary: NSE CEO Ashish Chauhan said higher F&O taxes will not deter small investors and called for a tax-based entry filter to protect them.
ne5642266fc.why: The National Stock Exchange of India runs the country's largest derivatives market, so changes to F&O taxes and access rules affect trading volumes and retail participation.

n2628254f05.headline: Government urged to limit pork imports
n2628254f05.summary: The farmers group SINAG is pressing the Philippine government to cut pork imports. The aim is to support local hog raisers and boost domestic production.
n2628254f05.why: Pork is a major protein in the Philippines, and import policy affects domestic hog producers and food prices. Changes to import quotas can shift demand between local and foreign suppliers.

n5b6ffd71ee.headline: Iran crisis threatens worst disruption in gas markets since 2022
n5b6ffd71ee.summary: A widening Middle East conflict threatens the biggest disruption to global gas markets since Russia's 2022 invasion of Ukraine. About 20% of global LNG exports pass through the Strait of Hormuz, now largely halted.
n5b6ffd71ee.why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of global LNG and oil trade, so disruption there affects energy prices and supply worldwide.
n5b6ffd71ee.why_moved: Ship-tracking data shows the Strait of Hormuz largely halted and LNG tankers pausing voyages, cutting expected gas supply.

n0f683fb683.headline: Oil markets brace for crude jump after US-Israel attack on Iran
n0f683fb683.summary: Oil markets are bracing for a reaction to the joint US and Israeli attack on Iran. Prices are expected to jump when trading resumes Sunday.
n0f683fb683.why: Crude oil is the world's most traded commodity, and its price feeds into inflation, transport costs and corporate margins.
n0f683fb683.why_moved: Traders expect supply risk from the attack on Iran to lift crude prices when markets reopen.

n43625e60d8.headline: Feb inflation seen picking up anew
n43625e60d8.summary: Headline inflation likely accelerated in February from January's two percent, driven by higher rice, fuel and utility costs, but stayed within the BSP's target range.
n43625e60d8.why: Inflation trends guide the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas, whose rate decisions influence Philippine bond yields and the peso.

n0e8168f3a0.headline: T-bill, bond rates to ease further
n0e8168f3a0.summary: Rates on Treasury bills and Treasury bonds offered this week could continue to ease, according to BusinessWorld.
n0e8168f3a0.why: Government securities set the benchmark for local borrowing costs and attract investors seeking low-risk yields.

nc71c70c8cb.headline: Analysts’ February inﬂation rate estimates
nc71c70c8cb.summary: Philippine inflation may have hit its fastest pace in over a year in February, as price pressures from higher costs built up. The figures are analyst estimates.
nc71c70c8cb.why: Inflation readings shape Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas rate decisions, which affect peso bonds, lending rates and equity valuations.

n995d827a81.headline: BSP mulls longer repayment for salary loans
n995d827a81.summary: The Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas is considering changes to salary-based consumer loan rules, including possibly removing the current tenor cap. The aim is more flexible repayment for borrowers.
n995d827a81.why: The Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas is the Philippine central bank and regulator, and its consumer lending rules affect banks and household credit.

na1890fc8b1.headline: Strong earnings, peso may push up PHL shares
na1890fc8b1.summary: Philippine stocks could extend their momentum this week on strong corporate results and a robust peso, although geopolitical risks remain. The outlook is a preview, not a confirmed move.
na1890fc8b1.why: The PSEi is the main benchmark of the Philippine Stock Exchange, and its direction reflects corporate earnings and currency conditions.

n29c3c0beed.headline: EU Imposes Drastic Tariffs on Chinese Goods: Is A Trade War Looming?
n29c3c0beed.summary: The European Union has imposed tariffs on Chinese goods, with commentary suggesting turmoil on the international trade front may continue.
n29c3c0beed.why: Tariffs on Chinese imports alter trade costs for European and Chinese manufacturers and raise the risk of retaliation.

n9c3b37a380.headline: ‘Philippine can weather impact of Middle East conflict’
n9c3b37a380.summary: Finance Secretary Frederick Go said escalating Middle East tensions are likely to have a temporary and modest impact on the Philippine economy.
n9c3b37a380.why: The Philippines is a large importer of oil, so Middle East tensions affect its fuel costs, inflation and growth outlook.

nec7c754d57.headline: PHL may hit IPO target this year — analysts
nec7c754d57.summary: Analysts expect the Philippines to meet its target of four initial public offerings this year as market conditions improve and regulatory hurdles ease.
nec7c754d57.why: IPO activity signals capital-market depth and gives investors new listings on the Philippine Stock Exchange.

nfd0353470f.headline: Meralco awaits ERC decision on P8-B cost recovery
nfd0353470f.summary: Manila Electric Co. said it is awaiting a decision from the Energy Regulatory Commission on its P8-billion cost recovery. The outcome will determine how the power distributor recovers those costs.
nfd0353470f.why: Meralco is the Philippines' largest power distributor, and regulatory decisions on cost recovery directly affect its earnings and power rates.
